name: Apollo 16 CSM
about: Apollo 16 CSM (1972-031A), a crewed vehicle (Apollo II), launched 1972 Apr 16. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1972 Apr 16), held fixed
docked to S06005; it stays docked here until it lands; the undocking is folded into the landing (a fudge of hours)
landing day from GCAT's end of mission (psatcat TDate), noon UTC standing in for the hour; the point stands in for the programme's usual recovery area, from memory

events.why: landing day from GCAT's end of mission (psatcat TDate), noon UTC standing in for the hour
